user.title: Dolby DSS220
user.description: Connect to the SMI web services of a Dolby DSS200/DSS220 server. The web services listen on the management network; on a server without a theatre network, set "Management network" to Auditorium in the Config script.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the server, for example 192.168.1.129.
data_description.port: Port of the SMI web services (default 8080).
data_description.allow_control: Allow Home Assistant to change playback, input, volume, douser and lamp. When off, the integration only reads the state.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check the address, port and network (VLAN, gateway and the management network setting of the server).
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or host name, without http:// or a path.
error.invalid_response: The server answered, but not like a Dolby DSS SMI web service.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different server.
